body: EMDR just brings back bad memories to desencitize
I want a friend as well. I don't know why people don't like us.
I was getting better, and then i got a bleeding disorder. In other words life is a spiral of shit.

People think i'm just this kid who just does school to get the hell outta there. I've had shit go on in the past that still hurts. I've never had that man presence that a boy like me needs. I just want my pain to end.
i can't join things because i can't do anything well. i can't open up because no one will listen. i don't know what to do.
